concerns.text: T030 describes sweeping 'across a range of small significance levels' for FR-007. The spec (FR-007) and plan explicitly mandate a specific set {0.01, 0.05, 0.1}. This semantic weakening removes the deterministic testability required for SC-004 (Jaccard index stability) and violates the FR-007 constraint.

T014 calculates retention percentage and T015 performs listwise deletion. The spec (SC-001) and plan require the pipeline to FAIL with error code E-DATA-INSUFFICIENT if retention < 80% BEFORE proceeding to expensive processing. The task order implies deletion happens after the check, or the check is not a hard gate, violating the 'fail fast' constraint of SC-001.

T025 states to 'perform conditional removal of predictors' if VIF > 5. The spec (Assumption 6) explicitly states predictors with VIF > 5 'will not be removed unless they cause model instability'. The task relaxes the constraint by implying removal is the default action for high VIF, violating the conservative data exclusion principle.

T014 mentions raising 'SystemExit' but omits the specific error code 'E-DATA-INSUFFICIENT' mandated by SC-001. This is a semantic weakening of the acceptance criterion, as automated pipelines rely on specific error codes for gatekeeping.
